message.content:
Build GAME SERVERS as a separate product with their own per-game pricing for Nxeon at /opt/nxeon. Other agents edit OTHER areas concurrently — touch ONLY YOUR OWNED FILES.

## PRIMER
- Next.js 15 App Router + Prisma. `"use server"` files export ONLY async functions. `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`; `import { requireUser, requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth"`; `import { requireArea } from "@/lib/rbac"`; `import { debitWallet, InsufficientBalanceError } from "@/lib/wallet"`. Money = integer cents. Design classes: `.card`,`.btn-primary`,`.btn-secondary`,`.btn-danger`,`.input`,`.table-shell`; `import { PageHeader, Badge, fmtMoney } from "@/components/ui/primitives"`.
- NEW model `GamePlan { id, gameFamily, name, ramMB, cpuCores, diskGB, slots(Int?), priceCents, termMonths, basePlanId, basePlan(Plan relation), osTemplateId(String?), featured, active, sortOrder, servers }`. `Server` now has `gamePlanId`. Game families in `import { GAME_FAMILIES } from "@/lib/games"`. Game OS images: `db.osTemplate.findMany({ where:{ family: <game>, category: "APPLICATION" } })` (game images have `family` = the game). VPS plans: `db.plan.findMany()`.

## TASK
Games need different resources, so each game gets its own pricing tiers (a `GamePlan` is one tier for one game). Build:
1. **Admin CRUD** `/admin/game-plans` (`requireArea("billing")`): list GamePlans grouped by game, create/edit (gameFamily, name, ram/cpu/disk/slots, priceCents, termMonths, choose a base VPS Plan for provisioning sizing, choose the game OsTemplate, featured/active/sort), toggle, delete. Use `components/admin/GamePlanControls.tsx`.
2. **Seed** `prisma/seed-gameplans.ts`: 2–3 sensible tiers for minecraft, valheim, rust, palworld, cs2, terraria (differing RAM/slots/price — e.g. Minecraft 2GB/10-slots cheap → 8GB/50-slots; Rust needs more RAM; etc.). For each, pick `basePlanId` = the smallest VPS Plan whose ramMB ≥ the tier's ramMB (fallback largest), and `osTemplateId` = that game's OsTemplate id if present. Idempotent upsert (dedupe by gameFamily+name). RUN it: `cd /opt/nxeon && npx tsx prisma/seed-gameplans.ts`.
3. **Marketing page** `app/(marketing)/game-servers/page.tsx`: premium, honest pricing page — each game with its tiers (RAM/slots/price), CTA to deploy. SEO metadata.
4. **Customer deploy** `app/dashboard/games/page.tsx`: pick game → pick tier → deploy. `orderGameServer(gamePlanId)` in `lib/actions-gameplans.ts`: READ `lib/actions.ts` `orderServer` for the pattern (do NOT edit it) — validate + atomic `debitWallet(gamePlan.priceCents)`, create `Server { name, hostname, userId, planId: gamePlan.basePlanId, gamePlanId, osTemplateId: gamePlan.osTemplateId, termMonths: gamePlan.termMonths, wantsDedicatedIp:false }` + a `PROVISION` Job in one transaction; redirect to the server.

## OWNED FILES (create ONLY these)
`lib/actions-gameplans.ts`, `app/admin/game-plans/page.tsx`, `components/admin/GamePlanControls.tsx`, `app/(marketing)/game-servers/page.tsx`, `app/dashboard/games/page.tsx`, `components/customer/GameDeploy.tsx`, `prisma/seed-gameplans.ts`.

## HARD RULES
NEVER touch: prisma/schema.prisma, next.config.ts, layouts, lib/actions.ts, lib/db.ts, lib/rbac.ts, worker/*, ROADMAP.md, docs/**, sitemap, or files not in your list. Do NOT run build/prisma-push/generate/restart (you MAY run the seed tsx). No commits, no new deps. `"use server"` = async-only.

## REPORT
Files created; how pricing + order flow work; confirm seed ran + how many GamePlans; INTEGRATION NEEDED (nav links to `/admin/game-plans`, `/dashboard/games`, `/game-servers`; note that renewal billing should charge `gamePlan.priceCents` when `Server.gamePlanId` is set); risks.

model Plan {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug          String   @unique
  name          String
  cpuCores      Int
  ramMB         Int
  diskGB        Int
  bandwidthTB   Float    @default(1)
  priceCents    Int
  storageTier   String   @default("nvme") // "nvme" | "hdd"
  active        Boolean  @default(true)
  sortOrder     Int      @default(0)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  servers       Server[]
  gamePlans     GamePlan[]
}

enum ImageCategory {
  PLAIN_OS
  CONTROL_PANEL
  APPLICATION
}

/// An installable image shown in the deploy wizard. Plain OS clones `baseVmid`
/// directly; control panels / apps clone `baseVmid` then run `setupScript`
/// (cloud-init runcmd) to install the panel/app on first boot.
model OsTemplate {
  id            String        @id @default(cuid())
  slug          String        @unique
  name          String        // display name, e.g. "Ubuntu"
  category      ImageCategory @default(PLAIN_OS)
  family        String        @default("linux") // ubuntu | debian | almalinux | rocky | cpanel | ...
  version       String        @default("")      // "24.04", "13", ""
  logo          String        @default("")      // icon slug for the UI
  vmid          Int           // legacy/base template VMID to clone
  baseVmid      Int?          // explicit base OS template for panels/apps (falls back to vmid)
  setupScript   String?       // shell installed via cloud-init runcmd (panels/apps)
  minRamMB      Int           @default(1024)
  minDiskGB     Int           @default(10)
  licenseRequired Boolean     @default(false)   // e.g. cPanel/Plesk need a paid license
  featured      Boolean       @default(false)
  sortOrder     Int           @default(0)
  active        Boolean       @default(true)
  servers       Server[]
}

model Server {
  id            String       @id @default(cuid())
  name          String
  label         String?      // customer-facing nickname (rename)
  hostname      String
  vmid          Int?         @unique
  status        ServerStatus @default(PENDING)
  ipAddress     String?      @unique
  sshPort       Int?         @unique
  rootPassword  String?
  isFree        Boolean      @default(false)
  autoRenew     Boolean      @default(true)
  suspendedNote String?
  expiresAt     DateTime?
  createdAt     DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime     @updatedAt
  userId        String
  user          User         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  nodeId        String?
  node          Node?        @relation(fields: [nodeId], references: [id])
  bwInBytes     BigInt       @default(0)
  bwOutBytes    BigInt       @default(0)
  bwWindowStart DateTime     @default(now())
  termMonths    Int          @default(1) // 1=monthly, 12=annual, 24=biennial, 36=triennial
  addons        Json         @default("{}") // { malwareScanner, dailyBackup, docker }
  dedicatedIp   DedicatedIp?
  wantsDedicatedIp Boolean   @default(false)
  projectId     String?
  project       Project?     @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  planId        String
  plan          Plan         @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  osTemplateId  String
  osTemplate    OsTemplate   @relation(fields: [osTemplateId], references: [id])
  jobs          Job[]
  portForwards  PortForward[]
  autoUpdate    Boolean      @default(false) // game-server auto-update opt-in
  claudeBuilds  ClaudeBuild[]
  gamePlanId    String?
  gamePlan      GamePlan?    @relation(fields: [gamePlanId], references: [id])
}

model PortForward {
  id         String  @id @default(cuid())
  serverId   String
  server     Server  @relation(fields: [serverId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  publicPort Int     @unique
  guestPort  Int
  protocol   String  @default("tcp")
}

model Job {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  type      JobType
  status    JobStatus @default(QUEUED)
  payload   Json?
  error     String?
  attempts  Int       @default(0)
  serverId  String?
  server    Server?   @relation(fields: [serverId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
}

model WalletTransaction {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  amountCents Int
  description String
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
}

model AuditLog {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String?
  user      User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  action    String
  detail    String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

model Setting {
  key   String @id
  value String
}

---GAMEPLAN---
model GamePlan {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  gameFamily String   // minecraft, valheim, rust, palworld, cs2, terraria, ...
  name       String   // e.g. "Minecraft — 4 GB / 20 slots"
  ramMB      Int
  cpuCores   Int      @default(2)
  diskGB     Int
  slots      Int?     // player slots (nullable)
  priceCents Int      // retail price the customer pays (per term)
  termMonths Int      @default(1)
  basePlanId String   // the VPS Plan used to size/provision the VM
  basePlan   Plan     @relation(fields: [basePlanId], references: [id])
  osTemplateId String? // the game's OsTemplate (image) to deploy
  featured   Boolean  @default(false)
  active     Boolean  @default(true)
  sortOrder  Int      @default(0)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  servers    Server[]
}

// ---- Editable email templates (DB-backed, admin-editable, {{variables}}) ----
model EmailTemplate {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  key       String   @unique // welcome, receipt, server_provisioned, ...
  name      String
  category  String   @default("Account") // Account | Billing | Servers | Domains | Support | Security
  subject   String
  html      String   // body with {{variable}} placeholders
  enabled   Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

// ---- Email log: every message sent, with rendered HTML for preview ----
model EmailLog {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  toEmail   String
  subject   String
  template  String?  // template key (welcome, receipt, ...)
  html      String   // rendered HTML for admin preview
  status    String   @default("SENT") // SENT | FAILED
  error     String?
  userId    String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

## Done — Game Servers product built for Nxeon

### Files created (all 7 owned files, nothing else touched)
- `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-gameplans.ts` — server actions
- `/opt/nxeon/components/admin/GamePlanControls.tsx` — admin CRUD client components
- `/opt/nxeon/app/admin/game-plans/page.tsx` — admin page
- `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/GameDeploy.tsx` — customer deploy client component
- `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/games/page.tsx` — customer deploy page
- `/opt/nxeon/app/(marketing)/game-servers/page.tsx` — marketing pricing page
- `/opt/nxeon/prisma/seed-gameplans.ts` — seed

### How pricing works
Each `GamePlan` is one tier for one game (RAM/cpu/disk/slots + `priceCents` + `termMonths`). Admins at `/admin/game-plans` (gated by `requireArea("billing")`) manage tiers grouped by game: create/edit via `GamePlanForm` (choose a base VPS Plan for provisioning sizing + the game's OsTemplate image, featured/active/sort), enable/disable toggle, and delete (refused while servers reference the tier). Marketing and dashboard both render tiers grouped by game, cheapest first, with a "Popular" badge on featured tiers.

### How the order flow works
`orderGameServer(gamePlanId)` mirrors `lib/actions.ts` `orderServer` (read, not edited): validates the tier + base plan are active, resolves the game image (tier's `osTemplateId`, else falls back to any active `family=<game>, category=APPLICATION` image), checks wallet balance, then in one `$transaction` does an atomic `debitWallet(gamePlan.priceCents)` + `walletTransaction` + creates `Server { planId: basePlanId, gamePlanId, osTemplateId, termMonths, wantsDedicatedIp:false, expiresAt }` + a `PROVISION` Job, then redirects to `/dashboard/servers/{id}`. Hostname is auto-generated (`<game>-<rand>`). `InsufficientBalanceError` is caught and surfaced.

### Seed
Ran `npx tsx prisma/seed-gameplans.ts` successfully: **14 GamePlans created** (Minecraft ×3, Valheim ×2, Rust ×3, Palworld ×2, CS2 ×2, Terraria ×2). Differentiated RAM/slots/price (e.g. Minecraft 2GB/10-slots $4.99 → 8GB/50-slots $15.99; Rust up to 10GB/150-slots; Palworld up to 16GB). Every tier resolved a matching base VPS plan (smallest with `ramMB ≥ tier`, Max as fallback) and a game image was present for all six families. Idempotent (dedupes by gameFamily+name; re-running updates in place).

### INTEGRATION NEEDED (owned by other areas — I could not add these)
- **Nav links**: add `/admin/game-plans` to the admin nav (billing section) in `app/admin/layout.tsx`; add `/dashboard/games` to the dashboard nav in `app/dashboard/layout.tsx`; add `/game-servers` to the marketing header/footer nav. Note: `/admin/game-plans` is not yet in `HREF_AREA` in `lib/rbac.ts` — it defaults to `platform` (ADMIN-only) there, but the page itself correctly gates on `requireArea("billing")`, so BILLING staff can reach it by URL. To let BILLING see it in nav, add `"/admin/game-plans": "billing"` to `HREF_AREA` (rbac.ts is not mine to edit).
- **Renewal billing**: the renewal/worker path should charge `gamePlan.priceCents` (not `plan.priceCents`) when `Server.gamePlanId` is set. My order flow already charges the game price and sets `expiresAt`; recurring renewal logic lives in worker/billing which I don't own.

- No DB unique constraint on `GamePlan(gameFamily, name)`, so admin create + seed both dedupe in application code — concurrent identical creates could theoretically double up.
